file: SPEC.md §17.2 (S2 row "What hidden parts can still reach", line 4426) and docs/spec/SPEC-evidence.md E-S2.12 (lines 876-877); behaviour in src/shared/Physics/Cover.luau 807-879 (rule A, hull rule)
problem:
Truly hidden round filler that reaches another part is kept and moves a tier. The SPEC's numbers for this case are stale and too small.

Why it happens: rule A only fires when a round part lies wholly inside ONE round hider, and the hull rule only when a facet's whole hull lies inside one. A rod or Ball that sits in a round pommel's band and runs on into the grip satisfies neither, so its band pieces read as showing.

Repro (scratchpad m2x-v1-4\crease_flip.luau, log out\crease_flip.txt). Canonical and valid. Start from F5 with three changes:
- pommel: a Ball 0.6 across at (0, 0.3, 0);
- blade Block: size y 2.85, pos y 2.805;
- tip: pos y 4.23.
Add 4 Blade Cylinders, size (0.13697, 0.08655, 0.08655), at:
- (0.09144, 0.529981, -0.038118), rot (0, 0.063277017687257728, 0.97409027227872502, 0.21712706069158158);
- (0.09144, 0.529981, 0.038118), rot (-0.97409027227872502, 0.21712706069158158, 0, 0.063277017687257728);
- (0.038118, 0.529981, 0.09144), rot (-0.68878583701613705, -0.10878840869419942, 0.68878583701613705, 0.19827562529404152);
- (0.038118, 0.529981, -0.09144), rot (0.68878583701613705, -0.19827562529404152, -0.68878583701613705, 0.10878840869419942).

Results:
- Every point of each rod's surface is at least 0.002048 inside the pommel or the grip (720 x 101 side points plus caps). The truth reads 0.000 % on 400,000 points.
- The build reads 6.574 % each and keeps all four.
- Through V1's emulator, Sharpening is 0.1827 Normal for the truth's row and for the design without rods, and 0.2083 Hard on the build.

Random search for truth exactly 0 (union_search.luau, out\usz_*.txt):
- Balls at the same crease: up to 4.77 %.
- C09 plus Blade rods r 0.025 inside its grip, reaching its guard (c09_rods.luau): 2 kept at 2.396 %. Every point is at least 0.0002 inside; Sharpening 0.1904 -> 0.1664, no tier.
- Balls in the crease of two pommel Balls: up to 2.704 %.
- Balls in the crease of a pommel Ball and a grip Cylinder: up to 2.762 %.
All of these are kept.

What the SPEC says:
- §17.2: "a Ball reaching from a pommel into the grip reads up to 2.04 % (truly 0; 1 of 15, |ΔD| 0.010, no tier), one in the crease of two pommel Balls at most 1.2 %".
- E-S2.12: "1 of 15 kept, 2.044 % read".
That 2.044 % comes from fix3/out/e4_c.txt, which the cover README marks as "V1's trial alone", without rule A. Those 15 Balls also lie wholly inside the pommel: on the build all 15 read 0.000 % (e4cd.luau, out\e4c.txt). The real straddles read up to 6.6 % and flip a tier.

§5 and §5.6 carve out "round filler ... that reaches another part". The lead's call rests on §17.2's "no tier", which is false.
fix:
1. Text, applied in my copy (scratchpad m2x-v1-4\tfix\repo; diff out\tfix_spec.diff).

In §17.2, replace "a Ball reaching from a pommel into the grip reads up to 2.04 % (truly 0; 1 of 15, \|ΔD\| 0.010, no tier), one in the crease of two pommel Balls at most 1.2 %." with:

"and round filler in the union of a round part and another part, truly hidden (every point of it at least 0.002 inside one of them), reads its facets in the round part's band too: 4 Blade rods r 0.043 × 0.137 where F5's grip enters that pommel read 6.57 % each and are kept, Sharpening 0.1827 Normal → 0.2083 Hard with the blade 0.25 longer (the truth's row 0.1827); Balls there read up to 4.8 %, rods in C09's grip reaching into its guard 2.4 % (Sharpening 0.1904 → 0.1664, no tier), Balls in the crease of two pommel Balls or of a pommel Ball and a grip Cylinder up to 2.7 %, all kept and truly 0 (the 2.04 % of one Ball straddling the pommel and the grip, earlier, was read without the part's own test: that Ball lies wholly in the pommel and reads 0)."

Correct the same two sentences in E-S2.12.

2. Code option for the lead, tried in scratchpad m2x-v1-4\fixP (diff out\fixP_cover.diff). After every hider, drop each polygon still showing on a round facet when its own hull (its vertices, each also pushed out by the facet's r/offset) lies in a round hider's true solid, as the buried-or-coincident piece asks. Results:
- The 4 crease rods read 0.000 %, so D is the truth's row.
- 0 verdicts move on all 33,389 plausible designs.
- Units rise 0.16 % in total, at most 2.7 % on one design.
- The Physics suite passes except Cover.spec (a), because CoverBrute would need the same rule, and the C09 units pin (21,851.25 → 21,881.5).

It is only partial:
- Balls at the crease still read up to 4.41 % at truth 0, and the two-Ball crease 2.68 %.
- Its result depends on how the subtraction fragments a facet.
- Pokes still read 15-16.7 %.

The lead decides; the SPEC text must change either way.

problem:
Round 3 adds an exception to §5's design promise ('Hidden filler … cannot move a tier, but for round filler … that pokes a hair out of it or reaches another part'). It has no **[Decision to confirm]** mark and no §17.1 O-number. §17.2 leaves the case 'open for the lead', and §5.5 (under Q7's mark) still says 'filler cannot buy a tier', which is now false. With no designer available, §0.3 and this workflow require the default to be marked with an O-number.

The exception matters, reproduced in m2x-v2-4/e5v.luau: F5 with its pommel a Ball 0.6 across, plus 4 Blade Balls (r 0.06–0.15) poking 0.0001–0.002 out of it along (1, ±1, ±1)/√3.
- 20 swords, all valid. 16 move Sharpening to Hard: every one with r ≥ 0.08, up to 0.3284 Hard at r 0.12; the truth's row gives 0.0989.
